candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML snapshot + diff of the board roster; use a browser-like user agent / headless browser because plain fetch returned 403. Cross-check via Google cache and the Albanian mirror path /Al/.

negative_findings.description: Direct WebFetch of https://bankassoc-kos.com/about-us/board-of-directors/ returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.
negative_findings.result_summary: The same site is well indexed with fresh content and other paths (/Al/komunikatat/..., /uploads/files/...) resolve in search results, so the 403 is almost certainly bot defence (WAF/user-agent filtering), not a dead page. Recorded as unverified-but-presumed-live; requires a headless browser or a realistic UA for collection.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is the single highest-value page in the cell. Mis-recording it as dead would silently drop the primary Kosovo bank-leadership signal from the collection plan.

negative_findings.description: AmCham Kosovo's legacy domain amchamksv.org 301-redirects to amcham.network.
negative_findings.result_summary: https://www.amchamksv.org/all-members/ returned 301 to https://amcham.network/. The new domain exposes tiered member directories, a committees category, board of governors and newsroom. Legacy deep links (e.g. /finance/, /financial-service/, the 2026 board-election story) still surface in search and may or may not redirect cleanly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any stored AmCham URLs from earlier runs will need rewriting; a naive liveness check on old deep links could mark good sources dead.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Kosovo association of payment service providers / e-money institutions was found in any of the three languages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in Albanian ('shoqata e pagesave elektronike', 'shoqata e institucioneve të pagesave', 'PSP anëtarë') returned only the banking association, the microfinance association and the FIKS fintech community. The nearest substitute is FIKS (fintechkosovo.com), which lists founding members but publishes no board or full membership roster.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: PSPs and e-money institutions — a core part of the payments actor map — are not covered by any association directory in Kosovo. Their enumeration must come from the CBK licence register instead (a different cell), not from the association layer.

negative_findings.description: A Kosovo insurance association (Shoqata e Siguruesve të Kosovës) could not be confirmed as an active, separately-governed body with a public member/board page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Albanian search surfaced bks-ks.org (apparently the Kosovo Insurance Bureau / Byroja Kosovare e Sigurimit) rather than a member association with published committees. Not fetched in this pass; treated as a lead, not a candidate.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Insurers are adjacent buyers of payments and IT infrastructure; if a governed association exists it would add another named-executive roster to the map.

negative_findings.description: STIKK membership scale and board composition are reported inconsistently across sources.
negative_findings.result_summary: Third-party profiles state '200+ members, 90% of the ICT market' while STIKK's own about page states 'over 100 members representing over 60% of the ICT labor market'. Search snippets also showed a board chaired by Burbuqe Hashimi (3CIS) whereas the live page shows Astrit Leti (Tive) as chairman with a substantially different roster.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the board page turns over between terms and must be snapshotted with an observed-at date; also a warning never to cite association scale figures without attributing the specific source and date.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language association sources for the banking/payments sector specifically are close to non-existent.
negative_findings.result_summary: Serbian queries ('Udruženje banaka Kosova', 'članovi upravni odbor') returned almost entirely Serbian-state institutions (Udruženje banaka Srbije, PKS) rather than Kosovo bodies. The only genuinely Kosovo-relevant Serbian-language material was general business-association organising covered by KoSSev and the parallel Privredna komora Kosova i Metohije.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Serb-majority north's financial-sector actors are not represented in any association directory reachable in Serbian; sr-language coverage for this cell will remain thin and must be met via news monitoring rather than directories.

negative_findings.description: No association-hosted job board for the Kosovo banking sector was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Neither SHBK, AMIK nor the chambers appear to run a sector vacancy board; only OEK's /konkurset/ and AmCham's own vacancy notices exist, and both are association-internal rather than sector-wide.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'jobs' topic cannot be served from the association layer in Kosovo; it must be sourced from bank career pages and commercial job portals (a different cell).

coverage_gaps.description: Payment institutions, e-money institutions and card acquirers have no association home in Kosovo, so the association layer cannot enumerate them.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route PSP enumeration to the CBK licence register and to FIKS event speaker lists; flag FIKS for re-check in 6 months to see whether it formalises a membership roster and board.

coverage_gaps.description: sr-language association coverage of banking/payments in Kosovo is effectively absent; only general Serb business-organising sources exist.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add keyword monitors on kossev.info and kosovo-online.com for 'privredna komora', 'udruženje privrednika', 'banka', 'imenovan/postavljen'; attempt a manual survey of komorakim.rs to see whether it publishes officers and members.

coverage_gaps.description: The Kosovo Banking Association domain rejects plain HTTP fetching (403), which blocks the cell's most important roster and news feed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Provision a headless-browser fetch path with a realistic user agent and rate limiting for bankassoc-kos.com; verify robots.txt terms before enabling scheduled collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Association rosters are published as current-state pages with no version history, so past board terms and departed committee members are unrecoverable after the fact.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Start dated snapshotting immediately for all roster pages (SHBK, STIKK, AMIK committees, AmCham, OEGJK, SCAAK) and backfill from the Wayback Machine to reconstruct prior terms.

coverage_gaps.description: The 'jobs/hiring' topic is only weakly served by this cell — associations name leaders but do not advertise sector vacancies.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Rely on STIKK's ICT labour-market reports as the only association-side hiring barometer, and hand the vacancy-feed requirement to the job-portal and employer-careers-page cells.

coverage_gaps.description: Several adjacent professional bodies were identified but not fully explored: IKAF, the insurance bureau (bks-ks.org), and any Kosovo association of internal auditors, compliance officers or HR professionals.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass on these bodies' governance and member pages; compliance and internal-audit bodies in particular map the risk-function leadership inside banks.

brief: Kosovo's association layer is unusually rich for people-mapping: SHBK (bankassoc-kos.com) publishes a board composed of member-bank CEOs plus a full bank directory, AMIK goes further and names Finance, Legal/Compliance, HR and Marketing committee members with their employing MFI, and STIKK publishes a dated board roster with company and title for every seat alongside a 100-200 member ICT directory. The chambers add crossover coverage — AmCham's tiered member directories and Financial Services committee, and the German-Kosovar chamber whose current chair is a serving bank CEO — while FIKS is the only place PSPs and fintechs surface at all, and it publishes no board. Two structural constraints: SHBK's site returns 403 to plain fetches (bot defence, presumed live, needs a headless path) and Serbian-language association coverage of the sector is effectively absent, leaving KoSSev news monitoring and the parallel Privredna komora Kosova i Metohije as the only sr-language routes. No association in Kosovo runs a sector job board, so this cell delivers leadership and organisation mapping strongly and hiring signals only weakly.
